description: Scans a bounded scope of a codebase for ONE named pattern and records each match via report_finding. Reads code; never modifies it. The pattern and the scope arrive in the dispatch message.

feedback_templates.cycle_suspected: [darkmux-runtime] You've called `{tool_name}` {count} times in {window_size} turns with the same arguments. You are re-reading ground you have already covered. Move to a file in your scope you have not opened yet, or stop and report your coverage.
